items.source: Auditing handler to mark entity objects created and modified.
items.translation: 审计处理器，用于标记已创建和修改的实体对象。

items.source: AuditingHandler extension that uses PersistentEntity.isNew(Object) to expose a generic IsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object) method that will route calls to AuditingHandler.markCreated(Object) or AuditingHandler.markModified(Object) based on the IsNewStrategy determined from the factory.
items.translation: 扩展AuditingHandler，使用PersistentEntity.isNew(Object)来暴露一个通用的 IsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object)方法，该方法将根据工厂确定的IsNewStrategy将调用路由到 AuditingHandler.markCreated(Object)或 AuditingHandler.markModified(Object)。

items.source: AuditingHandler extension that uses PersistentEntity.isNew(Object) to expose a generic ReactiveIsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object) method that will route calls to ReactiveAuditingHandler.markCreated(Object) or ReactiveAuditingHandler.markModified(Object) based on the IsNewStrategy determined from the factory.
items.translation: 扩展了AuditingHandler，它使用PersistentEntity.isNew(Object)来暴露一个通用的 ReactiveIsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object)方法。该方法将根据工厂确定的IsNewStrategy，将调用路由到 ReactiveAuditingHandler.markCreated(Object)或 ReactiveAuditingHandler.markModified(Object)。

items.source: AuditableBeanWrapperFactory that will create am AuditableBeanWrapper using mapping information obtained from a MappingContext to detect auditing configuration and eventually invoking setting the auditing values.
items.translation: 一个 `AuditableBeanWrapperFactory` 接口，它利用从 `MappingContext` 获取的映射信息来创建 `AuditableBeanWrapper`，以检测审计配置并最终调用设置审计值的方法。

items.source: Default DateTimeProvider simply creating new LocalDateTime instances for each method call.
items.translation: 默认情况下，DateTimeProvider 会为每次方法调用创建新的 LocalDateTime 实例。

items.source: A factory to lookup AuditableBeanWrappers.
items.translation: 用于查找AuditableBeanWrapper的工厂。

items.source: General support for entity auditing.
items.translation: 提供实体审计的一般支持。

items.source: Types to abstract authentication concepts.
items.translation: 用于抽象认证概念的多种类型。

items.source: Interface to abstract the ways setting the auditing information can be implemented.
items.translation: 用于抽象审计信息设置实现方式的接口。

items.source: Support class to implement auditing handlers.
items.translation: 支持类，用于实现审计处理器。

items.source: SPI to calculate the current time to be used when auditing.
items.translation: SPI 用于计算审计时使用的当前时间。
